definitions.gloss: nap; short sleep; catnap; brief rest
definitions.explanation: a short period of sleep, typically taken during the day to restore energy

examples.japanese: ⟦{昼休|ひるやす}み→昼休み：01715_hiruyasumi⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{仮眠|かみん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{取|と}った→取る：00565_toru⟧。
examples.english: I took a nap during lunch break.

examples.japanese: ⟦{長時間|ちょうじかん}→長時間：10165_choujikan⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{運転|うんてん}→運転：01335_unten⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{前|まえ}→前：02255_mae⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{仮眠|かみん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{取|と}る→取る：00565_toru⟧⟦{方|ほう}→方：01139_hou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦いい→いい：00118_ii⟧。
examples.english: You should take a nap before a long drive.

examples.japanese: ⟦{会社|かいしゃ}→会社：00607_kaisha⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{仮眠室|かみんしつ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧で、⟦{疲|つか}れた→疲れる：00901_tsukareru⟧{時|とき}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{休|やす}める→休める：02437_yasumeru⟧。
examples.english: There's a nap room at the company, so I can rest when I'm tired.

notes:
FORMS:
⟦{仮|かり}→仮：11551_kari⟧ (temporary) + {眠|みん} (sleep) → temporary sleep
{仮眠|かみん}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ (to take a nap)
{仮眠|かみん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{取|と}る→取る：00565_toru⟧ (to take a nap)

RELATED FACILITIES:
- {仮眠室|かみんしつ} (nap room)
- {仮眠|かみん}⟦スペース→スペース：11049_supeesu⟧ (nap space)

DIFFERENCE FROM OTHER SLEEP WORDS:
- ⟦{昼寝|ひるね}→昼寝：00106_hirune⟧ (afternoon nap) - casual, usually at home
- {仮眠|かみん} (nap) - more formal, can be at work
- ⟦うたた{寝|ね}→うたた寝：08036_utatane⟧ (dozing off) - unintentional, light sleep
- ⟦{居眠|いねむ}り→居眠り：01822_inemuri⟧ (nodding off) - falling asleep while sitting

WORKPLACE CONTEXT:
Many Japanese companies now recognize the benefits of napping and provide {仮眠室|かみんしつ} (nap rooms) for employees. Power naps of 15-20 minutes are recommended for productivity.
